purpose: Define content classes that PTGAE analysis and rewrite systems must preserve or treat as separately authorized material.

rules: Do not rewrite quoted source as group prose.
A translation or quotation correction is a separate operation with source/version provenance.
Do not rewrite code, fenced code, inline code, command syntax, data literals, or programming-language identifiers.
Do not rewrite package names, repository names, URIs, work_ref values, issue/PR IDs, hashes, schema keys, file paths, API fields, or protocol tokens.
Do not alter source titles, author names, URLs, DOIs, quoted titles, or citation locators as a style rewrite.
Do not rewrite equations, mathematical symbols, formal grammar, logical formulae, or defined notation outside the owning formal system.

Do not remove or upgrade explicit Observed, Measured, Inferred, Hypothesis, Model, Proposed, Required, Intended, Simulated, Unverified, Disputed, Deprecated, or Unknown status without evidence/authority.
A canonical terminology migration may change a defined term only with old/new term, scope, authority, aliases, affected consumers, and acceptance state.
Only semantics-preserving transformations authorized by the selected PTGAE bundle may run automatically.
